title: Word Ladder
hints: Each word is a node and two words are adjacent when they differ in exactly one letter. The shortest chain is a shortest path in an unweighted graph, so BFS. The real question is how to find neighbours fast.
Comparing every pair of words costs O(N^2 * L). Instead bucket the words by wildcard pattern: 'hot' belongs to '*ot', 'h*t' and 'ho*'. Two words are adjacent iff they share a bucket.

BFS from begin_word, expanding each word through its L patterns, and empty a bucket after using it (or keep a visited set) so no word is expanded twice. Return the level at which end_word is dequeued, counting begin_word as level 1.
